newsitem.title: USA: Procept makes gel to prevent HIV in women.
newsitem.headline: Procept makes gel to prevent HIV in women.

text.p: Procept Inc said on Tuesday it plans to develop a topical gel which women can use vaginally to help prevent HIV infection and other sexually transmitted diseases.
It said laboratory studies have shown that its PRO 2000 antiviral compound is active against a wide range of HIV strains from both the developed and developing world.
It said the gel is also active against other sexually transmitted disease pathogens, such as herpes simplex virus type 2.
Procept said it believes the manufacturing of the product is easy and stable, and it will be able to make sufficient quantities of it to meet anticipated worldwide demand.
